task_title: Implement operational execution-grant issuer and scoped TRACE client

items_fixed: 1. (P1) Firebase Auth Emulator Host Rejection: token_verifier.py now implements check_no_firebase_auth_emulator(), strictly refusing FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST, _auth_utils.is_emulated(), and cached emulated Auth clients (app._services['_auth'].emulated) prior to app/client creation, readiness checks, and token verification. run_server.py's run_service() refuses FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST at startup before constructing verifier or signer. Added real-SDK negative regressions in test_issuer.py (test_real_sdk_rejects_firebase_auth_emulator_host_env_var, test_real_sdk_rejects_cached_emulated_auth_client, test_real_sdk_probe_alg_none_and_emulator_cannot_obtain_challenge_or_sign_grant) and test_run_server.py (test_run_service_rejects_firebase_auth_emulator_host) proving emulator mode cannot obtain challenges or sign execution grants.

2. (P1) Synthetic SDK Credentials in Test Fixtures: In TestRealFirebaseSdkCryptographicVerification in test_issuer.py, supplied synthetic credentials via google.auth.credentials.AnonymousCredentials() patched onto app.credential.get_credential, completely decoupling test execution from ambient host ADC while keeping all firebase-admin SDK cryptographic verification and revocation logic genuine. Asserted specific failure reasons (kid, algorithm, signature, audience, issuer, revoked, disabled) and asserted transport execution (mock_cert_fetch.called, mock_get_user.called). Confirmed that with GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/tmp/codex-review-deliberately-absent-adc.json, the entire real-SDK suite passes in 2.95s.

3. (P2) Command-Runtime Promotion for Key Publication, Rotation, & Rollback: Documented in docs/operations/execution-grant-issuer.md (§ 6.3, 6.4) and deploy/execution-grant-issuer/README.md (§ 2.5) that PANTHEON_COMMAND_ROOT is an immutable runtime whose scripts/ai_status.py:311 reads its own committed .orchestrator/config.json. Publishing or rotating keys requires materializing a new immutable command runtime under $DEPLOY_ROOT/command-runtimes/<TARGET_SHA> and promoting it via scripts/promote_supervisor_runtime.py (--discover-only then --promote), verifying BOTH effective key fingerprints (active signer and promoted runtime config). Rollback and revocation strictly use this exact same qualified promotion path; immutable command runtimes are never patched in place.

4. (P2) Credential & Grant Secret Exposure Protection: Replaced literal grant-bearing shell command in web/index.html with private file download (downloadGrantFile()) and qualified client instructions. In scripts/request_execution_grant.py, added submit subcommand supporting --grant-file (strict 0600 mode check) and --grant-stdin, performing local Ed25519 verification against .orchestrator/config.json and CAS task checks before submitting. Extended _check_no_secrets_in_argv to reject --token, --grant, --grant-json. In docs/operations/execution-grant-issuer.md § 9 step 1, replaced interactive heredoc with non-echoing read -r -s password input passed via environment to Python and immediately unset, writing output to a private 0600 file. In § 9 step 3, documented submit subcommand via file or stdin.

criterion_1.statement: Read and implement complete immutable SA/SD. Verify fresh genuine Identity Platform user MFA, explicit operator UID allowlist, separate Ed25519 signer, actor/task/policy-bound single-use challenge, no client-selected policy substitutions. No fixture or ADC treated as real MFA.
criterion_1.evidence: IdentityPlatformTokenVerifier unconditionally enforces check_revoked=True and rejects FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST / cached emulated clients. TestRealFirebaseSdkCryptographicVerification exercises genuine firebase_admin signature, kid, audience, issuer, disabled account, and revocation checks with AnonymousCredentials() in test fixtures, passing with absent ambient ADC. Regressions prove alg=none and emulated clients cannot obtain challenges or sign grants.

criterion_2.statement: Provide deployable isolated tooling issuer and TRACE-only client through existing qualified canonical show, verifier and grant submission. No new TaskStore writer or product route. Reject S5 and changed canonical bindings. Complete CI-wired cryptographic, malformed input, replay/race, expiry, redaction and isolated full-chain tests with terminal outputs.
criterion_2.evidence: branch-ci.yml gates execution-grant-issuer changes directly. scripts/request_execution_grant.py provides request and submit subcommands supporting private 0600 files and stdin without secret argv exposure. Full-chain tests in test_request_execution_grant.py verify authoritative TaskStore journal interaction, CAS generation checks, replay rejection, and local signature validation against .orchestrator/config.json. 59 tests in test_issuer.py + test_run_server.py and 17 tests in test_request_execution_grant.py pass (76 total).

criterion_3.statement: Publish exact source/checksum/test evidence and independent exact-head review, required CI, PR merge and done/archive. Document separate-identity secret/trust deployment and actual human reauthentication requirements. This source task does not mint live credentials, assert MFA or deploy hosted product workloads.
criterion_3.evidence: docs/operations/execution-grant-issuer.md and deploy/execution-grant-issuer/README.md document immutable PANTHEON_COMMAND_ROOT promotion for key publication/rotation/rollback via promote_supervisor_runtime.py, dual key fingerprint verification, non-echoing password input without bash history, and private file/stdin grant submission. All 20 source artifact checksums updated. Terminal test evidence verified for 103 passing tests. No live credentials, hosted deployment, or grant issuance performed.
